The intensity distribution is expected to contain two major classes: object pixels + background pixels The engineer does not want to manually determine the threshold for every image. Your Task Use a grayscale object image such as the coins image associated with OpenCV's watershed example: Perform the following: 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. Convert the image to grayscale. Generate a histogram of the grayscale image . Apply Otsu's thresholding. Record the automatically selected threshold. Repeat the experiment after changing the image preprocessing slightly. Compare the automatically selected thresholds. contrast or Required Output Show : Original Histogram + Otsu Binary Mask Then answer: Why is Otsu useful when the programmer does not know threshold beforehand? the correct Your implementation must use Otsu Is thresholding rather than manually choosing the threshold, as specified in the manual.
